newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF expects no criticism if spending plan extended.
newsitem.headline: MOF expects no criticism if spending plan extended.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Friday that he does not expect any criticism to arise if the government stretches out a 10-year programme to spend 630 trillion yen on public works projects.

"At a time when the government is working on fiscal reforms which could determine the future of the country, I don't think there will be any criticism if we extend the public investment programme," he said.
He was speaking at a finance committee meeting in the Lower House of parliament.
